rows.en: Wait just a moment, will you!
rows.notes: Sheryl working as a Nyan-Nyan waitress, to customers; both genders.

rows.en: You'd better come back again!
rows.notes: Waitress Sheryl to customers; both genders.

rows.en: Sorry for dragging you into this mess.
That was some good exercise after a big meal.
rows.notes: Male; also ext_yui_004 (male) after the same work-off-the-bill gag.

rows.en:
Plus I got to see you in a Nyan-Nyan outfit,
Sheryl!
I-I hardly ever do favors like this, you know!!
rows.notes: Callback to c03349 (same 'konna saabisu' line, rendered 'favors' there); here the 'service' is her wearing the costume. Both genders.

rows.en: Hahaha, it looked good on you.
...W-well, of course it did!?
Now then, we're going home!
Sheryl-saaan!

\p-chan...
Fancy running into you in a place like this.

Sheryl-san, what's up? Why are you
hanging around in front of Nyan-Nyan?
Why don't you just go in?

I can go in on my own just fine, though~
Want to go in with me, then?
I-isn't that way too many!? Seriously!!
rows.notes: Female only; Sheryl just ordered 20 servings.

rows.en:
You eat a ton too, Sheryl-san.
You're so slim, so where does all that food go...?
I-I don't have that kind of money either!?
That was some good exercise after a big meal.

Plus I got to see you in a Nyan-Nyan outfit,
Sheryl-san!
Hahaha, it looked great on you.

I heard an interesting rumor...
That instead of the great Sheryl-sama,
you've been hanging out with that guy a lot.
rows.notes: Both genders. 'Ano otoko' ('that guy') is not named in the scene; kept vague.

rows.en:
(Hoshimura suddenly called me out here,
but...)
Is something going on at Nyan-Nyan?

I've been expecting you,
\p!!

...Hey, Hoshimura.
You're as hyper as ever today.

Heh heh heh...
Act all relaxed while you still can~
So why did you call me out here?
It's a showdown...!
A showdown?

Yup! Me 'n' ya, in a no-holds-barred
Nyan-Nyan eating battle!
rows.notes: Both genders. Her comic 'chimi' (for kimi) rendered 'ya'.

rows.en: ...Why?
Because it sounds fun!
Now then, here we gooo~!!
But whyyy~!!
I don't need to explain the rules, right?

Uh, yes you do!
I don't know anything about this.

Oh, last time it was Yuuto, wasn't it...
My bad, my bad.
rows.notes: Male only; Yuuto Kagura (given name as in the Japanese).

rows.en: (So Yuuto was a victim too...)

Here are the rules:
Whoever eats the most dim sum in an hour wins!
That's all there is to it.
That's simple enough.

If there's food left when time's up, you lose
points for it, so watch out you don't
order too much.
Sounds like timing my orders will matter too...

The restaurant isn't running this as an event,
so you'll need luck on your side too!
rows.notes: Both genders: the food comes at the kitchen's pace.

rows.en: So what happens if I win?
The loser foots the bill!!
Got it!
rows.notes: x3: ext_yui_001 both genders, frd_kgr_109 female (answering Kagura's 'watch me from below').

rows.en: Alrighty, here we go!
Nyan-Nyan Fight~!!
rows.notes: Both genders; 'Fight... Ready... Go!' call split over three rows.

rows.en: Ready~!
Go~!!
Now, what should I order?
Maguro bun
rows.notes: Choice, offered in all three rounds, both genders.

rows.en: Xiaolongbao
Red bean bun
I'll start with maguro buns!

That's the spirit!
Maguro buns for me too!!

When it comes to dim sum, it's xiaolongbao!
I'll beat the heat with sheer guts!
Yup yup, they're delicious!!
I'm going with the underrated red bean bun!
rows.notes: Male only ('jimi ni oishii': quietly tasty).

rows.en: So that's your move!

*munch munch*...
There's still plenty of time!

*nom nom*...
I'm not gonna lose!
Time to pick my second wave!
Shrimp dumplings
Sesame balls

Shrimp dumplings to switch up the flavor!
If I don't mix it up, I'm done for...!

Ku-ku-ku!
Spoken like a true rival of mine!!

It's the big crowd-pleaser.
I'd be crazy not to order it...!
rows.notes: Male only; follows the maguro bun choice in round two.

rows.en:
I can't fall behind!
Excuse meee, I'll have some too!!
Sesame balls, the secret fan favorite!
Heh heh heh, think improvising like that'll work?

Urp...
This is getting rough...
Time for the final sprint!

It's been ages since anyone held out this long...
Whaddaya say we dance to the bitter end!?
Time to pick my last order!
Mango pudding
Almond tofu

Meat would be a bad idea now...
This'll dodge the leftovers penalty!
rows.notes: Male only; follows the mango pudding choice.

rows.en: Ngh, I'm not gonna lose~!
I'll finish off with smooth, refreshing almond tofu!
Playing it safe to wrap things up, huh...!

uncertain: c03388: Sheryl's 'ano otoko' (that guy) the player supposedly hangs out with is never named; rendered 'that guy' for both genders.
c03373: same 'konna saabisu' wording as c03349 ('favors'); kept 'favors' as a callback though here it is the costume she means.
Dim sum choice names (no glossary entries): Xiaolongbao, Red bean bun, Shrimp dumplings, Sesame balls, Mango pudding, Almond tofu.
